sideA.text: PEARL and its possible cure are all they have left. The year is almost over and this is the last chance, so they have to find PEARL and start making a cure. They ask what Utopia's motives are, and whether Utopia is holding PEARL hostage.

sideB.text:
APRIL 15, YEAR 44

Two havens are gone. Without their supplies, the ability to continue is severely compromised, and the writer feels real despair. They ask whether someone would let them all die. They were condemned to the havens but had tried to help the whole world. If the havens are gone, then what?
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.
